purpose: Issue #52 channel bindings. This file does NOT define channels and does NOT grant permission. Channel names must already exist in distribution/source-routing.json, and publishing rights are read at run time from distribution/provider-policy.json, which stays authoritative. This file adds only what the media engine needs on top: which desk language a channel can carry, which already-existing account would carry it, and whether the platform's AI-content and disclosure position has actually been verified.

authority.note: Neither file is written by this engine.

out_of_scope_channels.instagram: Owned by the existing image/video distribution lanes (distribution/launch-now.json, trend-video-engine). One channel, one owning lane: the media engine does not queue against them.
out_of_scope_channels.line: Retention-only per distribution/provider-policy.json, not a publication channel.
out_of_scope_channels.pinterest: Visual-first surface owned by the image lane; no article format.

devto.account_evidence: No DEV account id appears anywhere in this repository. distribution/provider-policy.json records dev-community as adopted-connection-candidate with publishingEnabled false and a one-time RSS import configuration outstanding.
devto.ai_content_policy_note: The platform's current position on AI-assisted publishing has not been read and recorded. Until it is, an AI-derived draft cannot be auto-published here.
devto.one_time_owner_action: Connect the DEV account and configure the RSS import from https://stratumpraxis.com/feed.xml with canonical URLs pointing at stratumpraxis.com, then record the account id and the platform's AI-content position here.
devto.notes: The strongest English article fit in the current channel set: DEV officially supports RSS import and canonical URLs, which keeps the owned site as the canonical source.

bluesky.account_evidence: distribution/provider-policy.json records bluesky as priority-social-candidate with publishingEnabled false. No account handle appears in this repository.
bluesky.one_time_owner_action: Create or nominate the account, connect it, and assign a single owning publisher under the single-publisher rule in distribution/provider-policy.json. No account is created by this engine.
bluesky.notes: Only channel in the current set that could carry the Spanish desk. It is not connected, so the Spanish desk currently has no reachable channel.

threads.account_evidence: distribution/provider-policy.json records threads as priority-social-candidate with publishingEnabled false.
threads.one_time_owner_action: Confirm account ownership and publishing lane before any queueing.

note.account_evidence: distribution/provider-policy.json records note as active-manual-japanese-asset with publishingEnabled false. content/note-publish-queue/README.md records that no verified official publishing API was found and forbids private-endpoint or session-cookie automation.
note.one_time_owner_action: None available. note remains a manual lane owned by content/note-publish-queue/. The media engine does not queue against it.
note.notes: Listed so a Japanese source is not silently routed here. Neither desk is Japanese, so no desk maps to this channel.

current_state_summary.reason: No channel in this set satisfies all of: configured destination, authorised account, provider policy publishingEnabled, verified AI-content compatibility, and satisfied disclosure requirements. Every route therefore terminates at HUMAN_PUBLISH_REQUIRED or BLOCKED, which is the correct outcome rather than a gap to work around.
